question: Starting with $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{bmatrix}$, perform successively $C_2\to C_2-2C_1$ and $R_2\to R_2-3R_1$. Find the resulting matrix.
explanation:
Step 1: Begin with $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{bmatrix}.$$ The first transformation is $C_2\to C_2-2C_1$.
Step 2: Here, $C_1=\begin{bmatrix}1\\3\end{bmatrix}$ and $C_2=\begin{bmatrix}2\\4\end{bmatrix}$. Thus, the new second column is $\begin{bmatrix}0\\-2\end{bmatrix}$.
Step 3: The matrix becomes $$\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\3&-2\end{bmatrix}.$$
Step 4: Now apply $R_2\to R_2-3R_1$. The new second row is $[3,-2]-3[1,0]=[0,-2]$.
Step 5: Hence, the resulting matrix is $$\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&-2\end{bmatrix}.$$
